integrity: Exact symbolic face and vertex checks and a self-contained reproducibility program supplied; mathematical proof included.
scientific_limitations: Exact parallel-chord law is restricted to threefold symmetry directions of the regular octahedron and affine-equivalent images under the induced line measure; it is not an isotropic or all-direction chord law. Historical priority remains uncertain; independent scientific assessment has not been performed.
title: A mixed uniform–atomic parallel-chord law for the regular octahedron
